title: Analytic proofs of Andrews-Bachraoui identities related to two-color partitions with evens in one color
summary: Andrews and Bachraoui (\textit{Int. J. Number Theory} (2026)) studied the two-color partition function $F(n)$ of a non-negative integer $n$ wherein odd parts may appear in two colors (red and blue) and even parts appear in one color (blue). For any non-negative integer $n,$ they also considered some restricted versions of $F(n)$: $F_0(n)$: the number of partitions of $n$ counted by $F(n)$ such that the number of odd parts in red color is even; $F_1(n)$: the number of partitions counted by $F(n)$ such that the number of odd parts in red color is odd; $H(n)$: the number of partitions of $n$…
